layers.title: Paving Moratorium
layers.notes:
On August 8, 2017, the Buena Park City Council adopted an ordinance for a "Street Cut Moratorium" in the City of Buena Park. This ordinance is designed to help keep streets in good condition for longer periods of time. It does this by restricting excavation work on streets that have recently been paved. In an emergency, the work would still be allowed, but the ordinance also set stricter paving guidelines that the contractor must follow when they repair their excavations.

layers.title: Beats
layers.notes: The Buena Park Police Department divides the City into 5 general patrol beats. These beats are used for various purposes, including crime mapping and patrol assignments. "Beat 6" is a fictitious patrol beat for call purposes. Calls received from nearby locations but outside the Buena Park border are assigned to Beat 6.

layers.title: Centerline Ties
layers.notes: Centerline ties are survey lines that connect a point to other surveyed lines to determine the center of an intersection. These can be useful to engineers and architects when designing projects in order to determine exact property limits and Rights-of-Way (ROW). This feature class is used by City Staff to input centerline tie information into a mapping format, and connect each point to a scanned document. This data is also published on-line for general public access.
